This house of mine is a beautiful compact, 4 beds, 2 toilets, 2 parking wonder. All bed rooms have built in wardrobes, and the master has a walk in. Property has FTTP NBN ( High speed internet). There is central heating. Air condition is present in the living/dining area. 

It is centrally located, and is barely 350 meters from Tarneit Gardens Shopping Center ( Woolworths, Chemist Warehouse, Butcher, Groceries, Hair Dressers, Chinese Takeaway, Bubba Pizza, Fuel Station, El Jana Restaurant etc). It is also VERY close to schools such as Tarneit P9 College,  Tarneit Rise Primary School, St John the Apostle Catholic Primary School, Wimba Primary School, Good News Lutheran College. For public transport, there is a bus stop barely 200 meters from the house, with busses taking you to either Tarneit Station( Under 2.5k Away) or Tarneit West Station( Under 2.5km Away), Hoppers Crossing Station, Werribee Pacific Shopping Center. 

For those preferring to drive, the M1 Freeway is accessible from Leaks Road, which is barely 800 meters away. 

Great location, Under 10 years build, and taken care of like a prized possession.

Please note the WHOLE Property is up for rent. And further it is unfurnished.. I can arrange for a fridge and washing machine if required. 

I am not interested in leasing our individual rooms. You may sub lease with prior permission, and with an acceptable increase in weekly rental . 

At the moment I am looking at a rental of $550/Week with a bond of $ 2390.00 for the whole property. All bonds will be registered with the RTBA.
